attachments.insertion_landmark: 1st rib, posterior to the subclavian groove

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Largest and longest of the three scalenes; forms the posterior boundary of the scalene triangle.

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR2a. Proximal of three nerve-dense regions, about 0.95 cm2, formed by C5-C6 anastomosis. NOT recommended as a target: it overlaps scalenus anterior's region and the brachial plexus covers its upper part, so a perpendicular anterior approach is unsafe.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR2b. Middle of three, about 0.92 cm2, where branches from all levels anastomose. Centre of highest spindle abundance at 74.37% of muscle length, in its middle third. Puncture simulation found it unobstructed; this is the recommended target.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR2c. Distal of three, about 0.43 cm2, formed by C8 near the insertion. NOT recommended as a target: puncture simulation found a high risk of entering the pleural cavity. Recorded because a nerve-dense region that must not be injected is worth knowing about.

injection_target_points.label: centre of the region of highest muscle spindle abundance
injection_target_points.transverse_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.longitudinal_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.needle_path: Two finger-breadths above the clavicle, entered anterosuperior to posteroinferior through skin, subcutaneous fat, platysma and sternocleidomastoid, into the space below the transverse cervical artery and lateral to C5. The needle cannot be inserted vertically from the front, because the brachial plexus covers the upper part of the target.
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: Targets INDR2b, not the other two nerve-dense regions of this muscle. Depth is reported by the source in centimetres, as the mean of its own cadaver sample, so unlike a percentage it does not scale with the patient. Treat it as the depth to expect on the screen, not a setting to dial in. Deep cervical muscles sit under complex structures and the source recommends ultrasound guidance for all of them. Divided into five neuromuscular compartments by the C3, C4, C5-C6, C7 and C8 branch territories -- the most finely partitioned of the deep cervical muscles. Recorded as a note, not as functional_compartments, for the reason given on scalenus anterior. For scalenectomy the source recommends releasing the C5-C6 and C7 compartments. About 0.6 units at this target.
injection_target_points.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation
